title: Microsoft 365: PAYGO consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
description: Use the new PAYGO consumption-based meter to pay for your extra SharePoint storage needs. This reduces the operational overhead associated with purchasing extra storage packs and more seamlessly integrates with Microsoft 365 Archive.
